text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis in the opening sentence","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states a direct position early so the reader immediately knows what it is arguing."},{"evidence":"three organized body paragraphs","quality":"organizational structure","description":"The essay develops its argument in a more orderly progression with distinct points instead of a loose stream of comments."},{"evidence":"quote about \"half a million miles without a crash\" tied to a claim","quality":"textual evidence use","description":"The essay uses evidence from the article and explains how it supports the argument rather than just mentioning it."},{"evidence":"discussion of human error, safety, and leisure","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay presents multiple reasons and expands each one with some elaboration."},{"evidence":"restated position in the conclusion","quality":"conclusion effectiveness","description":"The essay closes by summarizing its main claims and reinforcing its stance."}]}
